senses.gloss: (b. h.) to marry the wife of a brother who died without issue.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 2:1">Yeb. II, 1</cite> <he>ואח״כ י׳ וכ׳</he> and afterwards the second brother married &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 2:6">Ib. 6</cite> <he>ואחד מְיַבֵּם</he> and one of the brothers may marry her.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 4:5">Ib. IV, 5</cite> <he>או חלוץ או יַבֵּם</he> either discharge (v. <cite ref="H01109"><he>חָלַץ</he></cite>) or marry (her).

<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 4:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מצוה בגדול ליַבֵּם</he> on the eldest brother the duty devolves (in the first order) to marry the deceased’s widow. Ib. II, 7 <he>לא יְיַבְּמוּ וכ׳</he> the other brothers must not both marry, but one discharges one, and the other &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: , Nithpa. נִתְיַיבְּמָה to be married by the yabam. Ib. I, 2 חולצת ולא מִתְיַבֶּמֶת she must take off the yabam’s shoe, but cannot be married to him. Ib. 4 נִתְיַיבְּמוּ if they have been married &c. Ib. 20ᵇ לא תִתְיַיבַּמְנָה ought not to be &c.
units: Num. R. s. 21 ואם לאו תִּתְיַיבֵּם אמנו and if daughters are not considered as legal heirs, let our mother be taken in marriage by the yabam; a. fr.
